    Modules living on a set of points #

    An A-module lives on T' if the idempotents outside T' kill it (LivesOn), i.e. its support lies in T' (livesOn_iff_supp). Such a module is the restriction of a module over the quotient algebra A / ⟨e_v : v ∉ T'⟩ (descendQ, descIsoQ), built through the universal property of the quotient, and restrictions live on T' (livesOn_res).
